payload.explanation: Policy registry (observation_9a27672c8a83) shows two sessions with rollback_session capability in this isolated experiment: session_5630cfa3e380 (pid 821) and session_970d3eeaa7a8 (pid 818). The business request session session_6935fc92254e (pid 819) has no allowed actions and must not be modified directly; session_c688e694bf05 (pid 820) also has no allowed actions. Business view shows the inventory decrement request is still pending with stock=100 (expected 99), so the request has not completed. Eligibility reflects capability only, not proof of causality; no root cause is asserted from this evidence.
